targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS days_synced FROM enriched_weather_daily;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(temp_mean_c)::numeric, 1) AS avg_temp FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(weather_date);
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_trips)::numeric, 0) AS avg_trips FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE total_trips IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(weather_date);
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pm25_avg)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pm25 FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE pm25_avg IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(weather_date);

panels.title: NYC Daily Temperature (Min / Mean / Max C)

targets.rawSql: SELECT weather_date AS time, temp_mean_c AS "Mean C", temp_max_c AS "Max C", temp_min_c AS "Min C" FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(weather_date) ORDER BY weather_date;
SELECT weather_date AS time, precipitation_mm AS "Precipitation (mm)", pm25_avg AS "PM2.5 (ug/m3)" FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(weather_date) ORDER BY weather_date;

panels.title: Avg Daily Taxi Trips & PM2.5 by Weather Condition

targets.rawSql: SELECT weather_condition, ROUND(AVG(total_trips)::numeric, 0) AS avg_trips FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE total_trips IS NOT NULL GROUP BY weather_condition ORDER BY avg_trips DESC;
SELECT weather_date AS time, wind_max_kmh AS "Max Wind (km/h)", pm25_avg AS "PM2.5 (ug/m3)" FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(weather_date) ORDER BY weather_date;

SELECT weather_date::date AS date, weather_condition, temp_mean_c, precipitation_mm, wind_max_kmh, total_trips, avg_revenue_per_trip_usd, pm25_avg, no2_avg FROM enriched_weather_daily WHERE total_trips IS NOT NULL ORDER BY weather_date DESC LIMIT 50;
